title: MCC-Core Governance Capability Profile
description: Framework-neutral, versioned, declarative statement of the MCC-Core governance capabilities an adapter supports. It does NOT grant execution authority, replace runtime authorization, or weaken fail-closed enforcement. The pure-Python semantic validator (mcc_compliance.capability_profile.validate_profile) is authoritative and additionally enforces cross-field invariants this schema cannot express (supported/unsupported disjointness, mandatory baseline coverage, self-declaration-only certification).

adapter.description: Adapter identity. framework is descriptive metadata only, never normative.

integration_contract.description: Integration Contract version the adapter implements.

compliance.description: Compliance suite / vector-set the adapter has been tested against.

certification.description: Adapter-declared certification. A raw profile may only self-declare; trusted VALIDATED/CERTIFIED status is produced by the Certified Adapter Program, never by the adapter.

runtime_capabilities.description: Supported baseline (mandatory) and/or optional governance capabilities. All baseline capabilities must appear here.

optional_capabilities.description: Supported optional capabilities (subset of the optional registry).

unsupported_capabilities.description: Explicitly unsupported optional capabilities. Must not overlap supported, and must not include a baseline capability.

constraints.description: Structured, per-capability constraints. Keys must be supported capabilities; values are structured objects (no opaque prose as the sole machine input).

metadata.description: Open forward-compatibility namespace for non-normative descriptive data.
